11: Hashem is not like man that He should act falsely. That He should not bring them to the land that He promised to them. In addition, that He should change His mind. He is fully capable of fulfilling His promise. Therefore, there is nothing from Hashem's standpoint preventing Him from keeping His promise. Likewise, there is nothing from the standpoint of the recipient preventing Him because (v. 21), One does not see evildoers in Yaakov (Akeidah).
